name: NodePress Self-Hosted Headless CMS
free_limit: MIT-licensed self-hosted headless CMS with REST and GraphQL APIs, visual content types, forms, roles, and unlimited self-managed use; no vendor-enforced free quota or expiry is stated.
watch_out: Self-hosting requires user-provided compute, PostgreSQL, Redis and deployment resources; email delivery, domains and third-party integrations can incur costs. No managed cloud allowance is included; new project with smaller ecosystem.
